systems.platform: Publish and subscribe model; portal, web services and bulk data transfer
systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation (project owner); Central Informatics Bureau (project management); hosted at the Government Online Centre
systems.tiers: Government agencies as publishers and subscribers (33 publishers, 192 connections, 628 e-services on the page)

note: InfoHighway is an exchange platform with no interoperability framework named behind it; no fact.
